book.name: SOHN
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Sises Widen Nehn Sapwellime Tohnpadahk ko

Eri, rahn tehr ehu mwohn Sarawien Pahsohpa. Sises ketin mwahngih me sapwellime ahnsou lelehr en mweselsang sampah wet oh ketilahng rehn Seme. E kin ketin loalloale sapwellime kan me mihmi nin sampah, oh e ketin loalloale irail lel ni imwi.
Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko wie konokonot en soutik. Tepil ahpw kainangihadahr Sudas Iskariot, nein Saimon, pwe en pangala Sises.
Sises mwahngih me Seme ketikihong ni lime manaman unsek. E pil mwahngih me e ketidohr sang rehn Koht oh pil pahn pwurala reh.
Sises eri ketida sang nin tehpelo, oh ketikihsang sapwellime likoun liki, e ahpw ketikihda daul ehu oh pirekihdi lukepe.
E ahpw ketin wudekihdiong pihl nan peisin ehu oh tapihada widenki patehnehn sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, oh pil limwiheki daul me mihmi nin lukepe.
Ni eh lel rehn Saimon Piter, Piter ahpw patohwanohng, “Maing ei Kaun, ia duwe, komw pahn ketin widen patehnehi kat?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ke sohte ese dahme I wiewia ahnsou wet, a mwuhr, ke pahn wehwehkihda.”
Piter ahpw patohwanohng, “Komw sohte pahn widen patehnehi kat!” Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ma I sohte pahn widen patehnehmw kan, ke sohte pahn kak wia nei tohnpadahk.”
Saimon Piter eri sapeng, patohwan, “Maing ei Kaun, kaidehn patehnehi katte me komw pahn widen, pwe pil pehi kat oh pil moangeiet!”
Sises ketin mahsanih, “Sohte katepen me duhduhwer en pwurehng dahlimw, pwehki e mwakelekelehr; ihte, en widen patehneh. Eri, kumwail koaros mwakelekelehr, a metehmen me soh.”
(Pwehki Sises mwahngih ihs me pahn pangala; ihme kahrehda e ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail koaros mwakelekelehr, a metehmen me soh.”)

Ni eh ketin widenehr patehnehrail ko koaros, e ahpw ketin pwuhriong nan sapwellime likoun likio, oh pil ketin sapahllahng mwoale nin tehpelo. E ahpw keinemwe, mahsanih, “Ia duwe, kumwail wehwehki dahme I ahpwtehn wiahiong kumwail?
Kumwail kin kahdanekin ie Sounpadahk oh Kaun; eri, me pwung amwail nda met, pwe iei ngehi.
Ngehi amwail Kaun oh Sounpadahk, me ahpwtehn widen patehnehmwail kan. Kumwail eri uhdahn pahn widen patehnehn emenemen kumwail.
I wiahiong kumwail mehn kahlemengi ehu, pwe kumwail en pil wia duwehte me I ahpwtehn kasalehiong kumwail.
I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: sohte ladu men mie me kin lapalapasang eh soumas; sohte sounkair men mie me lapalapasang me kadarala.
Met kumwail eseier padahk mehlel wet; eri, ia uwen amwail peren ma kumwail pahn kapwaiada!
“I sohte koasoakoasoia duwen kumwail koaros, pwe I ese me I piladahr ko. Ahpw mahsen en Pwuhk Sarawi uhdahn pahn pweida, me mahsanih, ‘Emen me iang ie mwengemwenge pahn pelian ie.’
Eri, ahnsou wet I ndaiong kumwail mepwukat mwohn eh pahn wiawi, pwe ni eh pahn pweida, kumwail en pwoson me ‘Ngehi iei ngehi.’
I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: me kin kasamwo mehmen me I kadarewei, ngehi me e kin kasamwo; oh mehmen me kin kasamwo ie, iei ih me kin kasamwo ih me ketin kadariehdo.”
Sises Kohpada duwen Eh pahn Pengpengla
Ni Sises eh ketin mahsaniher mepwukat, e ahpw pil kupwurohla, oh mahsanihada, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: emen sang nanpwungamwail pahn pangiehla.”
Tohnpadahk ko inenen pwonopwonkihda duwen mahsen wet oh kilengkipene nanpwungarail, me ihs ih me e ketin mahmahsaniheki met.
Eri, emen nanpwungen tohnpadahk ko, me Sises kin ketin loalloale, mwomwohd limwahn Sises.
Saimon Piter ahpw tuweleklahng, oh nda, “Kalelapak mahs reh ihs me e mahmahsanih.”
Tohnpadahk ko eri tohreklahng mpen Sises oh patohwanohng, “Maing at Kaun, ihs met?”

Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “I pahn kaduhwedi kisin pilawa kiset nan dahl wet, oh kihong; iei ih aramaso.” Eri, e ahpw ketikihda kisin pilawa kis oh kaduhwedi, ahpw ketikihong Sudas, nein Saimon Iskariot.
Ni ahnsowohte me Sudas ale kisin pilawao, Sehdan ahpw pedolong nan eh mohngiong. Sises eri mahsanihong Sudas, “Mwadang wiahda dahme ke uhdahn pahn wia!”
(Sohte emen rehrail wehwehki dahme Sises ketin mahsanihkihong met Sudas;
pwehki Sudas eh kohkohwahki edin mwohnio, ekei tohnpadahk ko kihkihong me Sises mahsanihong en kohieila oh pwainda dahme re anahne ong kamadipwo, de e pahn kisekisehki me semwehmwe kan mehkot.)
Sudas alehte kisin pilawao, oh mwadengete pedoila. Ahnsowo wasa pwongier.
Kosonned Kapwo
Mwurin Sudas eh pedoier, Sises eri mahsanih, “Iei ahnsou me lingan en Nein-Aramas pahn sansalada. Ahnsou wet lingan en Koht sansaladahr pwehki ih.
Ma Nein-Aramas pahn kasalehda lingan en Koht, eri, pein Koht pahn ketin kasalehda lingan en Nein-Aramas. E pahn ketin wiahda met ni ahnsou mwadang.
Samwa ko, I sohte pahn ieiang kumwail ahnsou werei. Eri, kumwail pahn rapahkin ie, ahpw met I pahn ndaiong kumwail dahme I ndaiong mehn Suhs ko: ‘Kumwail sohte kak kohla wasa me I kohkolahng ie.’
I pahn kihong kumwail kosonned kapw ehu: kumwail en poakpene nanpwungamwail. Duwen ei poakohng kumwail, iei duwen kumwail en poakpene.
Pwe ihme aramas koaros pahn esehki me kumwail nei tohnpadahk, ma kumwail pahn limpoakpene.”
Sises Kohpada duwen Piter eh pahn Kahmahmkihla

Saimon Piter ahpw kalelapak, patohwan, “Maing at Kaun, ia wasa komw pahn ket ie?” Sises ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Ke sohte kak idawehniehla wasa me I pahn kohla ie ahnsou wet; ahpw mwuhr ke pahn kak idawehn ie.”
Piter pil pwurehng kalelapak, “Maing ei Kaun, dahme kahrehda I sohte kak idawehnkinkomwi ahnsou wet? I onopadahr I en mehkinkomwihla!”
Sises ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Ke uhdahn kaunopada ke en mehkiniehla? Eri, I ndaiong uhk ni mehlel: mwohn malek eh pahn kakorot, ke pahn kahmahmki pahn silipak me ke sehse ie.”
